implReport.summary: Delivered all three deliverables: (1) 102 written codex entries, one per id of `allCodexIds()` (63 fixed + 4 species + 27 materials + 8 habitats), each a 69-104 word naturalist note with an optional "in the game" line, a citation line and related links, plus a pure lookup API; (2) journal/alert/hint/aim/relation/death-cause/founding-failure/diagnostic wording tables keyed by the contract id sets, and a wording review of existing strings (change table in notesForIntegrator); (3) a nine-page player manual in docs/manual (20 sections marked `<!-- verify-at-release -->`) and a controls reference generated from the bindings table, embedded in the manual and compared in a test. Every fact in the codex is backed by a verbatim dossier quote that a test re-reads from docs/research and checks is not tagged estimated or unsupported (406 quotes); 25 sampled entries are traced sentence by sentence. 54 tests in 5 files pass in about 2.5 s; typecheck is clean for src/content. No shared contract or core file was touched; only new files under src/content/** and docs/manual/**.
verification: npx vitest run src/content -> 5 files, 54 tests passed, about 2.5 s (the machine had load average about 26). Run once; no whole-suite run.
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json filtered to src/content and docs: no errors. The only errors in the project output are 3 in src/sim/nest/spoilUnits.test.ts (another engineer's work in progress).

Scratch node --experimental-strip-types scripts (in the scratchpad, not committed) re-checked before the vitest run: 102 of 102 expected ids present and none extra; body length min 69, max 104 words; 406 provenance quotes found verbatim in the dossiers with no unsourced tag after them; the 25-entry trace covers 123 sentences with 183 claim links.

Wording self-test: the banned-pattern checker flags 'We found it!', the quoted-speech case and the words enemy, victory, truce, soldiers, battle, and passes the rival wording ('Neutral', 'Wary', 'Clashing', 'Territorial dispute', 'Lull'). The only allow-listed phrase is the mandated title 'Orders without a commander' (GDD 06 §10; the manual also quotes it).

The controls table embedded in docs/manual/02-controls.md equals controlsMarkdown() output exactly (test). All 78 button actions and 14 axes appear; 60+ key mentions written as `Key`<!--key:action--> in the manual prose are each checked against the default bindings.
No harness run or screenshots: this task is text only and has no visual output.
Not run: FOUNDRESS_LONG sweeps (none exist; nothing in this module is slow).

acceptance.evidence: src/content/codex/sample25.ts maps every one of the 123 sentences of 25 entries either to claim indexes or to a stated hedge/framing reason. Claims are verbatim dossier quotes (provenanceBio.ts, provenanceWorld.ts). provenance.test.ts re-reads all five dossiers via ?raw and checks every quote exists, carries no unsupported/estimate marker, and is not followed by an [E]/[EST]/[MEM]/[NF]/[2ND]/[U]/[UNVERIFIED] tag in its table cell, and that the trace covers each sentence. Mapping (dossier: key quotes): lasius-niger species => L 3.4-5.0 mm, 8.0-9.0 mm, no morphological sub-castes, max 28 years, under stones/paving/wood that the sun warms, typical 4,000-7,000, monogynous. camponotus species => C third-season majors, queen about 19 mm, they do not eat wood, mostly nocturnal, 2,000-4,000, parent and satellite nests, 6-16 mm, native to central/eastern USA. messor species => M Myrmicinae S. Europe, lab colony 2-15 mm, macrocephalic, dead arthropods 1.82%, monogynous, inter-lineage hybrids, permanent trunk trails, refuse pile. atta species => A up to 2 million, sandy/loamy soil, only Atta in USA, workers do not eat leaves, summer night foraging, strongly polymorphic. queen-reserves => L 33.1 +/- 6.0 mg, newly mated mass not found. brood-stages => L ontogenesis 52 d, 19-23 C, stage endpoints undefined, silk cocoons; C legless grubs, eggs clump. nanitics => L 1.08 vs 1.15 mm (~6%), more efficient at brood care; C 4-25 workers. claustral-founding => L/C/M/A claustral mode, small burrows, 'would most likely not survive' (assumption stated as such), 99%. trail-pheromone => L ~20% ignore, <150 pg, acidopore, 84% laid trail; M/A persistence. route-memory => L memory+pheromone, 23.5-26 mm/s, 5.9-6.5 BU/s. home-range => L non-volatile CHCs, gradient, 'long lasting'. cofounding => L 18-25%, 2-5 queens, fecundity decides; A A. texana workers do not eliminate co-foundresses. nuptial-flight => E 97% July/Aug, far less synchronised; L >13 C, wind <6.3 m/s, >25 C; C March-July mode May; A clear moonless nights. satellite-nests => C parent/satellite contents, drier-warmer, 2-25. wood-moisture => C >=15%, not termites, 15.2 cm, brood failure. trunk-trail => M 1-30 m, persist, ~20% depots; A kept clear. seed-classes => M 0.08-95.9 mg, 4-50 mg, <0.4 mg soft edge, 1.5 cm burial. hybridogenesis => M lineages, 2.4 males, 13.4%, 20:22. fungus-garden => A 1-2 mm pieces, 6 weeks, 21-25 C, 20% protein. leaf-cutting => A 25 s/mm at 25 C, 77 s at 15 C, burden 1.2-1.5. garden-waste => A 45 of 169, heap workers, half as long. mound-structure => L CT scans, 5,390/7,099 cm3, ~30%, 5.9 mm, ~12 mm. honeydew => L incomplete diet, melezitose, 0.75 uL, 84%; C preferred food. antlion => E dry loose sand, angle of repose, 2 in x 3 in. habitat-asphalt => E >50 C, 52.2 C, 36.3 C shaded, not diggable. Sentences that are hedges are labelled in the trace and must contain a hedge word (test).

findings.title: Count templates are ungrammatical for a count of one ("Only 1 ants remain")
findings.where: src/content/text/alerts.ts (last-ants, food-p-low, raid-seen, alates-ready, weather-change, food-c-low), src/content/text/journal.ts (FLIGHT_ENTRY, LOSS_ENTRY, WINTER_REPORT.survived); failing test src/content/text/text.verify.test.ts 'plural and count wording'
findings.detail: formatText only substitutes tokens, so the plural noun is fixed in the template. alertText('last-ants',{n:1}).title gives 'Only 1 ants remain'. This is the common case: the queen alone is the last ant. Also reproduced: '1 larvae, 1 P stored', '1 workers', 'within 1 game hours', '1 winged ants', and in the journal '1 queens mated' and 'Lost 1 workers'. This breaks the wording quality bar of GDD 08 section 6.4 for the critical last-ants alert. A small plural helper or a count-aware template (singular and plural forms keyed by n) fixes it. The two verify tests stay red until then.

findings.title: Two codex entries share the title 'Asphalt' in the same category

findings.title: Fact trace is only partly machine-verified; some quotes are cut off before their numbers
findings.detail: The test checks that a cited claim index exists, not that the claim supports the sentence. Several quotes stop before the figure they back (Messor 'a laboratory colony from S. France spanned', the 0.08 to 95.9 mg seed range, antlion 2 in by 3 in converted to 75 by 50 mm). My trace.verify.test.ts requires every digit string in a traced sentence to appear in the cited quotes. It passes at a tolerance of 15% (8 of 61 numbers miss). I checked each miss by hand against the dossiers and all are legitimate: truncated quote, unit conversion, 5.9 mm rounded to 6 mm. The sample-of-25 criterion is therefore met. The remaining 77 entries have verified quotes but no per-sentence trace, as the report says.

findings.title: Provenance claim tables ship in the runtime bundle only to derive a citation string
findings.where: src/content/codex/index.ts imports citationOf from provenance.ts, which pulls provenanceBio.ts and provenanceWorld.ts (about 37 KB of source quotes)
findings.detail: When the codex panel imports '@/content', all 406 verbatim dossier quotes are bundled. Only the one-line citation per entry is needed at runtime. Keep the citations in a small map beside the entries and move the claim tables to a test-only module. Nothing imports src/content yet, so this is not urgent.

findings.title: Hardcoded default key letters in codex in-game lines and some state-dependent journal sentences
findings.where: codex entries cx-trophallaxis (G), cx-nursing (E), cx-antennation (T), cx-interface-markers (Delete); src/content/text/milestones.ts ms-first-heat-wave, ms-first-storm, ms-first-frost
findings.detail: The interface-time entry promises that 'Rebinding a key changes the key hint in the game too', but those four lines name default keys in plain text and go stale after a rebind (my test only confirms they match the current defaults). Use a token such as {key:share-food} resolved by controlsForEntry. Some milestone texts state outcomes as fact: heat-wave 'The pavement was too hot to cross' (Woodland Edge has no pavement), storm 'Every forager was recalled; the nest held', frost 'Underground, the colony is above freezing'. They came from GDD 06 and were left as written. Also ms-first-flight says 'a single morning's rush', which sits oddly with cx-nuptial-flight ('far less synchronised') and with night-flying Atta.

findings.title: Species tags widened beyond GDD 06 section 10 without being listed in the report
findings.detail: Each widening is justified by the body text (it mentions Atta, Camponotus, Messor or Atta respectively) and the dossiers. It changes which entries show under the species filter, so it should be recorded as a deviation from the GDD table. My test pins the four deviations so any further change is noticed.
